editorial.blurb: A hidden-gem spot serving up tender, well-seasoned grilled steaks and hand-rolled tamales with genuine care and attentive service.
editorial.insiderTip: Go on a weeknight like Tuesday when you'll likely walk right in; start with the complimentary salsas and chips, and order the Pork Taco Dinner—reviewers rave about the tender red pork and handmade tortillas, with no complaints.
